from pathlib import Path
from fractions import Fraction
import ast,hashlib,json,platform,subprocess,sys,time
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import linprog
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/'scripts'))
import v22_local_repartition,verify_v22_local,finalize_v22_local
from analyze_runtime_partition import triangle_distance
ROOT=Path.cwd();TASK=ROOT/'debug/issue25/v22-local'
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def git(*args,cwd=ROOT):return subprocess.check_output(['git',*args],cwd=cwd)
def read(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
pre=read('reports/nero-gripper-v22-local-preregistration.json');data=read('reports/nero-gripper-v22-local-partition.json');r=read('reports/nero-gripper-v22-local-verification.json');old=read('reports/nero-gripper-v2-runtime-partition.json')['entities'];cells=data['entities']
assert sha('reports/nero-gripper-v22-local-partition.json')==r['candidate_file_sha256']
assert v22_local_repartition.geosha(cells)==data['geometry_sha256']==r['candidate_geometry_sha256']
assert git('show','6eba4f3:reports/nero-gripper-v2-runtime-partition.json')==Path('reports/nero-gripper-v2-runtime-partition.json').read_bytes()
for f,h in pre['v21_policy_sha256'].items():assert sha(f)==h
assert sha('scripts/v22_local_repartition.py')==pre['builder_sha256']==data['builder_sha256']
assert sha('scripts/verify_v22_local.py')==r['verifier_sha256']
assert sha('scripts/finalize_v22_local.py')==r['finalizer_sha256']
for line in git('diff','642d3b0','--name-status').decode().splitlines():assert line.startswith('A\t'),line
sources=read('reports/nero-gripper-collision-sources.json')['local_frozen_inputs']
for f in sources:assert sha(f['path'])==f['sha256']
worktrees=read('reports/nero-gripper-v21-provenance.json')['protected_worktrees_unchanged']
for path,snapshot in worktrees.items():
 assert git('rev-parse','HEAD',cwd=path).decode()==snapshot['head']
 assert git('status','--short',cwd=path).decode()==snapshot['status']
changed=set(data['modified_entity_ids']);bit_identity=[];containment=[]
for a,b in zip(old,cells):
 if a['id']not in changed:
  assert json.dumps(a,separators=(',',':'))==json.dumps(b,separators=(',',':'))
  assert np.array(a['vertices_m']).tobytes()==np.array(b['vertices_m']).tobytes()
  assert np.array(a['faces']).tobytes()==np.array(b['faces']).tobytes()
  bit_identity.append(a['id']);continue
 assert a['semantic_family']in v22_local_repartition.ALLOWED
 # Continuous convex containment modulo NUM: every new vertex is within
 # NUM/16 of an EXACT positive convex combination of frozen old vertices.
 # This bounds material-set distance, unlike small plane residuals alone.
 av=np.array(a['vertices_m'])*1000;bv=np.array(b['vertices_m'])*1000;proof=[]
 for point in bv:
  lp=linprog(np.zeros(len(av)),A_eq=np.vstack([av.T,np.ones(len(av))]),b_eq=np.r_[point,1],bounds=(0,None),method='highs',options={'primal_feasibility_tolerance':1e-9})
  assert lp.success,(a['id'],lp.message)
  ids=np.flatnonzero(lp.x>0);w=[Fraction(float(lp.x[j]))for j in ids];total=sum(w);w=[x/total for x in w]
  residual=[Fraction(float(point[k]))-sum(alpha*Fraction(float(av[j,k]))for alpha,j in zip(w,ids))for k in range(3)]
  upper=float(np.linalg.norm([float(x)for x in residual]))+1e-12
  assert upper<=1e-7/16,(a['id'],upper)
  proof.append({'point_mm':point.tolist(),'old_vertex_indices':ids.tolist(),'nonnegative_normalized_rational_weights':[str(x)for x in w],'distance_to_exact_convex_combination_upper_mm':upper})
 containment.append({'entity':a['id'],'maximum_vertex_distance_upper_mm':max(q['distance_to_exact_convex_combination_upper_mm']for q in proof),'vertex_certificates':proof,'continuous_proof':'Distance to a convex set is convex; maximum at polytope vertices. Exact rational convex combinations belong to the frozen baseline cell.'})
assert len(bit_identity)==314 and len(changed)==32 and len(cells)==346
assert all(q['status']=='PASS'for q in r['minimum_entity_scale']['entities'])
assert r['mandatory_11']['status']=='FAIL'and r['mandatory_11']['pass_count']==10
# Independent exhaustive facet distance, bypassing the BVH for every actual
# inward A failure. Include interval-size reserve, not just sample equality.
tri=np.concatenate([np.array(e['vertices_m'])[e['faces']]*1000 for e in cells]);distances=[]
for q in r['independent_all_tier_point_scan']['A']['certified_source_exterior_runtime_void_failures']:
 d=float(np.sqrt(triangle_distance(np.array(q['source_point_mm']),tri).min()))
 assert abs(d-q['distance_to_all_closed_facets_mm'])<=1e-10 and d-1e-7>.01
 assert q['runtime_membership']['state']=='VOID'and q['source_exposure']['confirmed']
 distances.append({'source_face':q['source_face'],'source_point_mm':q['source_point_mm'],'exhaustive_closed_facet_distance_mm':d})
# Independently recompute every continuous burial inequality from fresh hull
# planes; an actual local normal counterexample does not rely on an atlas.
eq={e['id']:__import__('scipy').spatial.ConvexHull(np.array(e['vertices_m'])*1000).equations for e in cells};margins=[]
proofs=[q['independent_normal_failure_certificate']for q in r['mandatory_11']['records']if q['status']=='FAIL']+r['all_A_sidewalls']['new_real_normal_counterexamples']
for proof in proofs:
 assert proof['normal_deviation_lower_bound_deg']>.05
 for row in proof['strictly_buried']:
  cover=row['proof']['entity'];assert cover!=row['entity']
  p=np.array(row['polygon_mm']);v=float(np.max(p@eq[cover][:,:3].T+eq[cover][:,3]));assert v<-1e-7;margins.append(-v)
assert r['historical_unresolved']['rechecked_count']==r['historical_unresolved']['remaining_unresolved']==10
for f in Path('reports').glob('nero-gripper-v22-*.json'):read(f)
scripts=['scripts/v22_local_repartition.py','scripts/verify_v22_local.py','scripts/finalize_v22_local.py']
for f in scripts:
 tree=ast.parse(Path(f).read_text());compile(tree,f,'exec')
 assert not any(isinstance(n,ast.Import)and any(a.name.startswith('mujoco')for a in n.names)or isinstance(n,ast.ImportFrom)and(n.module or'').startswith('mujoco')for n in ast.walk(tree))
 assert not any(isinstance(n,ast.Call)and(isinstance(n.func,ast.Name)and n.func.id.startswith(('mj_step','mj_forward','mj_collision'))or isinstance(n.func,ast.Attribute)and n.func.attr.startswith(('mj_step','mj_forward','mj_collision')))for n in ast.walk(tree))
imports={}
for name,module in list(sys.modules.items()):
